title: SBI Probationary Officers PO Pre Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: 1500 Probationary Officer vacancies; Prelims call letter for Phase-1
qualification: Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university as on date specified in notification
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years (as per SBI PO notification; category relaxations apply)
selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Psychometric Test / Group Exercise & Interview → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Registration Number/Roll Number and Password/DOB; printed call letter; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://sbi.bank.in Careers section
2. Open PO Prelims Admit Card / Call Letter link
3. Enter Registration Number and Password or DOB
4. Download and print call letter
5. Appear for Prelims on 1-2 August 2026
shortDescription: SBI PO Prelims Admit Card 2026 released on 22 July 2026 for 1500 posts. Exam on 1 & 2 August 2026 at sbi.bank.in.
content:
State Bank of India has released the SBI PO Prelims Admit Card 2026 on 22 July 2026.

Phase-1 (Prelims) will be held on 1st and 2nd August 2026 for 1,500 Probationary Officer vacancies under Advt. CRPD/PO/2026-27.

  • Download call letter from SBI Careers
  • Carry printed call letter and original photo ID
  • Check shift timings and centre carefully
